title: lint: a declared `transferBehavior: 'cascade'` that can never be offered parses silently (parent without Change Owner, extension-added field, child API exposure without update)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Filed by seat 2 from the reviews of PR #36525 (#35315): L1 finding 6 and contract review S2 (7102103286). Not claimed.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:spec`

## What

The runtime is safe, because `transferCascadeRelations` re-judges every relationship and never offers an ineligible one. But in three places the author gets no refusal at author time, so the declaration is inert (ADR-0049 declared but not enforced):
1. `cascade` on a reference to a non-`sys_` parent that does not offer Change Owner (`ownership: 'org' | 'none'`, `managedBy`, or `userActions.transfer` off). This is cross-object, so it belongs in lint or the stack level, not field parse.
2. A field added through `ObjectExtensionSchema.fields` or `fieldPatches` to an object that does not offer Change Owner. The object-level refusal `refuseIneligibleTransferCascades` runs only on `ObjectSchema`.
3. A child whose declared API exposure does not serve `update` (`change-record-owner.ts`, the exposure filter in `transferCascadeRelations`).

## Ask

Add one `@objectstack/lint` (or `defineStack`) rule that refuses or warns on each case, naming what to change. The ruling (7000907189 point 4) allows "parse or lint". Land after #36525.
